de: Artificial intelligence is not to be held accountable, the doctor says. Here are six rules: which model to choose, what not to enter and what to write in the report.

d: Банк России при принятии решений по ключевой ставке ориентируется не только на годовую инфляцию, но и на текущие темпы роста цен и устойчивые компоненты, об этом рассказал "РГ" советник главы Банка России Кирилл Тремасов.

de: When making decisions on the key rate, the Bank of Russia focuses not only on annual inflation, but also on the current rate of price growth and sustainable components, adviser to the head of the Bank of Russia Kirill Tremasov told RG.

te: Lavrov commented on Poland’s plans to open production of Patriot missiles
de: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov called for a careful study of Russia’s military doctrine, commenting on Poland’s plans to host the production of Patriot missiles.

d: С 9 по 11 октября в Москве пройдут мероприятия Международного фестиваля НАУКА 0+. В год 65-летия первого полета человека в космос главной темой фестиваля станет "Твоя космическая Вселенная". Посетителей ждет масштабная космическая…

d: Испанский визовый центр обновил тарифы для российских заявителей. Так, визовый сбор вырос на 1,5 тысячи рублей - до 8840 рублей, сообщает Ассоциация туроператоров России (АТОР).

de: The Spanish Visa Application Centre has updated the rates for Russian applicants. Thus, the visa fee increased by 1.5 thousand rubles to 8840 rubles, according to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR).

d: Сегодня на территории туристско-рекреационной ОЭЗ "Ведучи" работают пять резидентов. Общая сумма заявленных ими инвестиций - 8,2 миллиарда рублей. Соглашениями предусмотрено создание около 1,3 тысячи мест размещения.

de: Today, five residents work on the territory of the tourist and recreational SEZ Veduchi. The total amount of their declared investments is 8.2 billion rubles. The agreements provide for the creation of about 1.3 thousand accommodation places.

de: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak instructed to strengthen control over fuel prices, according to a press release on the government website published following a meeting on the situation on the fuel market.

de: In Dagestan announced a storm warning. Bad weather is also expected in Ingushetia. Rescuers are warning residents in both regions to be cautious in the next two days.

te: In St. Petersburg, train passengers will be able to pass through the turnstiles on the NFC
de: Passengers of suburban trains in St. Petersburg and the Leningrad region have the opportunity to pass through turnstiles with the help of NFC. This can be done with tickets issued in the appendix "RZD Passengers".

de: The Governor of the Ulyanovsk region Alexei Russian instructed the regional Ministry of housing and communal services around the clock to deal with the restoration of the infrastructure affected by the attack of the UAV.
